title: Lyn Alden Says Bitcoin's Cycle Low May Be Behind It After Leverage Flush
text:
Lyn Alden Says Bitcoin's Cycle Low May Be Behind It After Leverage Flush | TokenPost 
 Advertisement Thursday, October 29, 2026 Sections Sign in News Markets Feed Watch Data Research Home Insights & Views 1 min read Add as a preferred source on Google Lyn Alden Says Bitcoin's Cycle Low May Be Behind It After Leverage Flush
 Alden says fast-money traders have largely exited, while fresh demand may take time to return as investors weigh technology and economic risks.
 By Token Post Published Oct 29, 2026, 2:52 AM EDT Save Share Mentioned assets BTC Bitcoin 
 An unmarked brass coin rests below a slack chain in a steel trough / TokenPost.ai Lyn Alden said Bitcoin's cycle low may already be behind it, pointing to leverage being flushed out and fast money largely exiting the market. She said a return of fresh demand may take longer.
 Alden said buyers may want evidence that Bitcoin's cryptography can withstand risks from artificial intelligence and quantum computing before demand strengthens.
 She also discussed macroeconomic conditions affecting Bitcoin's outlook.
 A prior examination of factors shaping Bitcoin's next halving cycle considered adoption, investor demand, regulation and macroeconomic conditions.
